title: Group Project Coordinator — Overview and definition
body: Public edition. Public tool knowledge, fact-checked reference. Assigns responsibilities and tracks team progress fairly. The Group Project Coordinator assigns responsibilities and tracks team progress. It divides the project into tasks matched to members' strengths and availability, sets milestones with owners, and tracks who has done what — so free-riding is visible early and the work stays balanced. Status updates keep everyone honest without awkward confrontations.
capabilities: Divide work by strength and availability
Keep work balanced across the team
